objective: Prevent production teacher-auth issue routes from minting signed teacher session cookies when trusted-cookie issuer proof or OIDC token expiry would produce a zero-second session lifetime.

behavior.before: The teacher-auth issue route could return 200 and emit Set-Cookie headers when upstream auth evidence was technically valid but too close to expiry, producing Max-Age=0 teacher-auth cookies.
behavior.after: The teacher-auth issue route returns 403 with redacted progress and no Set-Cookie headers when trusted issuer proof or OIDC token expiry cannot mint at least one second of teacher-auth session lifetime.

checks.failureMode: trusted-cookie issuer branch returned 200 instead of 403
